title: MQ Inbox Promotion Orchestration v1
description: The ranked promotion inbox mq-agent produces from mqobsidian's canonical exports. This schema locks the SHAPE of a ranking result; it is not truth about memory state. mqobsidian owns the candidates, the scores, the evidence, and the policy weights/thresholds echoed in `policy`; mq-agent owns only the join, the weighted formula, and the bucket routing. A `bucket` of `auto-promotable` means eligible for operator approval — never an unattended write. Ranking is deterministic: the same exports always produce the same document.

schema.description: Schema discriminator. Consumers must match this exact value before trusting the shape.

source.description: The producer identity of the inbox surface this ranking was computed from. Carried through from mqobsidian; mq-agent does not mint a new source identity for derived output.

generated_at.description: When the underlying inbox surface was materialized — NOT when the ranking ran. Ranking is a pure function of the exports, so the export's timestamp is the meaningful freshness signal.

policy.description: The owner policy this ranking was computed under, echoed so a result is explainable without re-reading the vault. Informational only: mqobsidian remains the sole authority for these values.

review_threshold.description: Ranked score at or above which a candidate reaches review-needed.

auto_threshold.description: Ranked score at or above which a candidate is eligible for approval (auto-promotable), absent any review reason.

min_supporting_factors.description: How many factors must be non-zero before support counts as broad rather than single-signal.

block_negative_feedback.description: When true, any negative feedback bars a candidate from the auto path.

weights.description: Per-factor weights applied to the score record's factors.

counts.description: Candidate tally per bucket. The three counts always sum to the length of `candidates`.

candidates.description: Every ranked candidate, ordered by ranked_score descending with memory_id breaking ties.

memory_id.description: The mqobsidian memory this candidate refers to.

state.description: Promotion state as published by the inbox. Only pre-promotion states appear in an inbox.

bucket.description: Routing decision. `auto-promotable` means eligible for approval, never an unattended write. Any review reason bars the auto path.

ranked_score.description: Policy-weighted sum of the factor contributions.

contributions.description: Per-factor weight*value, so a ranked_score can be explained term by term rather than trusted.

supporting_factors.description: How many factors were non-zero, before weighting. Weighting cannot manufacture breadth of support.

provenance.description: Deduplicated evidence that resolved through memory-evidence-manifest.v1. An opaque or unresolvable ref never appears here.

ref.description: The published evidence ref, resolvable in the evidence manifest.

producer.description: Who observed it (e.g. repo-signal, mq-mcp). Evidence sources never own promotion truth.

review_reasons.description: Why this candidate is barred from the auto path, if it is. Reported even when the candidate is too weak to be near the auto path, so a data problem is never hidden behind a low score.
